# UNIVERSITY DESTINATIONS
BIS Hanoi graduates secure places at some of the world's most prestigious universities.
Their personal and academic success takes them to top 100 institutions like Cambridge, Yale, King's College London, Stanford, UCLA, and the University of Hong Kong.
...
## Top universities around the world
Between 2016 and 2026, our graduates have been accepted by more than 400 prestigious universities around the world.
## The US
The most popular destination is the United States, and includes top institutions like Stanford University, Yale University, University of California, Berkeley (UCB), University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), Columbia University, Princeton University, and New York University (NYU).
## The UK and Europe
The UK is the second most popular choice of destination.
Our graduates were accepted by prestigious Russell Group institutions including University of Cambridge, Imperial College London, UCL (University College London), the University of Manchester, King’s College London (KCL), London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), University of Bristol and the University of Warwick, which were all ranked in the QS Top 10 Universities in the UK 2026.
Elsewhere in Europe, our students gained places in France, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.
## Rest of the world
Australia and Canada are also popular destinations, with students accepted by leading universities like the University of Sydney, the University of Melbourne, and the University of Toronto.
In Asia, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Singapore remained popular destinations.
Our graduates were accepted by elite institutions like University of Hong Kong (HKU), Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), Korea University, Yonsei University, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology KAIST, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), and National University of Singapore (NUS).

content.text:
BIS Hanoi graduates receive offers from universities across the world. The school’s published list includes:

- **US:** Stanford, Yale, Columbia, Princeton, UCLA, UC Berkeley, and New York University  
- **UK:** Cambridge, Imperial College London, UCL, King’s College London, LSE, Edinburgh, and Manchester  
- **Canada:** University of Toronto and McGill  
- **Australia:** University of Melbourne and University of Sydney  
- **Asia:** University of Hong Kong, HKUST, National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, KAIST, and Yonsei  

These are examples from the school’s reported offers and destinations; individual graduates’ choices vary by year. [BIS Hanoi’s university destinations](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/academic-excellence/university-destinations)
